# JustTalk AI

> JustTalk is an English speaking practice product built around one compounding context. You take a 1-on-1 class with a real tutor from the marketplace, practice the same material between classes with AI role-plays built from that class, and the insights generated along the way feed the next class. Nothing resets between sessions.

JustTalk helps intermediate and advanced English learners build speaking confidence through:
- 1-on-1 classes with real tutors, taken inside the JustTalk classroom with live tracking, shared notes and AI insights
- AI role-plays built from your own lessons and replayed with different personas
- AI personalities that remember previous conversations, so you pick up where you left off
- Insights that accumulate: active vocabulary by level, the mistakes you repeat, what to practice next
- IELTS Speaking mock tests with an estimated band across all four official criteria
- Progress tracking and CEFR-based progression (a globally recognized standard)
- Real conversations rather than grammar drills or scripted exercises
- Access on the web and through a native iOS app

## How It Works

1. Book a 1-on-1 class with a tutor from the marketplace and take it inside JustTalk
2. Live tracking and shared notes capture the class — corrections, new words, and the focus you agreed on
3. Between classes, speak with AI role-plays built from that lesson, with different personas
4. Insights accumulate along the way: active vocabulary by level, repeated mistakes, and what to practice next
5. Your tutor sees those insights before the next class begins
6. Each pass around the loop carries everything from the one before, so no session starts from scratch

## AI Practice Features

- Memory and continuity: the AI remembers previous conversations and builds on them
- Adaptive conversations: real conversations, not drills, that adapt to your level and needs
- Multiple personalities: practice with personas that are supportive, challenging, assertive or analytical
- Role-play scenarios: realistic situations with a choice of role and difficulty
- Ongoing series: multi-session role-plays that unfold over several sittings with continuity
- Personalized scenarios: tutors can design custom role-plays for a specific student
- Smart corrections: grammar and pronunciation feedback without interrupting your flow
- Pronunciation analysis: feedback on pronunciation and accent
- Vocabulary tracking: active vocabulary by CEFR level, and the words you avoid
- Progress analytics: speaking metrics tracked across every session

## Live Tutoring (JustTalk Tutors)

- Seamless integration: tutors can access your AI practice history and insights
- No starting over: your speaking history travels with you, so there is no re-diagnosis
- AI assistant for tutors: teachers can chat with an AI to reach student interests, lesson summaries and conversation history
- Customized scenarios: tutors can create AI role-plays tailored to each student
- Progress continuity: change tutors without losing progress, because the data stays with you
- Speaking-first lessons: focused on real communication rather than worksheets
- Flexible teaching: tutors set their own rates and manage their availability

## IELTS Speaking Preparation

- A full 12-minute mock test covering all three parts: the Interview, the Long Turn cue card, and the Discussion
- An AI examiner runs the test in the same shape as the real exam
- Scored against the four official criteria: Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammar, and Pronunciation
- An estimated overall band, plus which criterion is holding the score back
- Targeted drills to practice before the next attempt
- The band is an unofficial estimate that supports, and does not replace, certified IELTS assessment

## Programs

- Ambassador Program: for teachers who bring the students they already teach. JustTalk keeps 10% of student payments, that rate is locked for 10 weeks, and ambassadors get 10 free lessons to hand out. Applications for the first cohort close 30 September 2026.
- Creator Program: for creators, writers and community builders. Up to 50% revenue share on referred subscriptions, with the exact rate agreed during onboarding.

## Product Information

- Target audience: intermediate to advanced English learners who want to improve by speaking
- Core value: what you say is tracked and reused, so each session builds on the last and progress compounds rather than resetting
- Language: practice is English only; the marketing site is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese and Russian
- Assessment: CEFR-based progression (Common European Framework of Reference)
- Pricing: subscription tiers (Basic and Premium) with monthly and annual billing, shown on the JustTalk AI page (https://justtalk.ai/ai). Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Live tutoring is priced per session by individual tutors
- Platform access: web app at chat.justtalk.ai, iOS app on the App Store, tutor and teacher platform at app.justtalk.ai
- Status: AI practice is fully available on web and iOS; the live tutor marketplace is launching soon, with a waitlist open at https://justtalk.ai/platform
- Privacy: conversations are private and used only to improve the learner's own experience
